name: async-test-harness-local-evidence
proofObligationReason: The fixture source is a bounded Go test selection; local Glade test output with zero cases is not credited.

evidence.notes: Local AsyncOptions maximumQueueableStackDepth limits queueable chaining during the test harness drain.
Local async drains record Completed, Failed, and Aborted job status values for modeled jobs.
Local async drains record modeled job types such as BatchApex and BatchApexWorker.
Local batch drains record total chunk counts for modeled Batchable jobs.
Local batch drains record processed chunk counts for modeled Batchable jobs.
Local batch drains record modeled execute and finish errors on AsyncApexJob rows.
Local completed and failed modeled Batchable jobs receive a CompletedDate value.
The local test harness records the ChangeDataCaptureEnabled flag without contacting Salesforce services.
The local continuation harness invokes the named controller callback and returns its response.
The local test harness builds deterministic SendEmail QuickAction defaults for the supplied context and reply Ids.
The local Object overload accepts PageReference values stored as Object; arbitrary Object values are not claimed.
The local install test harness invokes InstallHandler.onInstall with a deterministic InstallContext.
The local install test harness passes isPush through InstallContext for the three-argument overload.
The local uninstall test harness invokes UninstallHandler.onUninstall with a deterministic UninstallContext.
The local notification harness dispatches executeAction and returns the handler ActionResult.
The local sandbox post-copy harness builds SandboxContext and invokes runApexClass.
The local sandbox post-copy harness accepts isRunAsAutoProcUser for the five-argument overload.
The local event-bus test broker delivers queued platform events and runs local platform-event triggers.
The local external-service test harness returns deterministic objects and rejects live-service execution.
WebServiceMock values registered through Test.setMock route generated SOAP callouts locally.
SOAP mock dispatch increments callout limits and materializes response map/list shells without live transport.
Stored continuation responses are visible through local continuation response lookup.

source.content: Focused async and test-harness tests cover queueable stack depth, publish-immediate limits, durable AsyncApexJob status/count fields, CDC flag recording, continuation callback invocation, send-email QuickAction defaults, PageReference-through-Object current-page setup, install/uninstall callbacks, notification action handlers, sandbox post-copy callbacks, external-service live execution fencing, and WebServiceCallout mock response materialization.
Local Apex test harness tests assert deterministic async, event, and continuation behavior.
